dataset.created_at_representation: Filtered Parquet/filtered card describe a string; embedded upstream card describes int64 Unix milliseconds. The transformation/serialization lineage and timezone semantics remain unresolved.

created_at_provenance_audit.transformation_rewrites_created_at: not demonstrated by reviewed filter-generation excerpt

selected_cohort_api_reconciliation.retrieved_via: Connected GitHub integration; GitHub issue/PR metadata for the identifier encoded in each instance_id

prior_exposure_exclusions.rationale: PR #1374 is the fix PR for issue #1371; PR 193 records target debugging/reproduction and explicitly states the candidate is excluded under the prior-exposure rule.

PR 194 records a static pre-reproduction source/fix review of the cohort row; the candidate's mechanism and fix were exposed before blinded confirmatory validation. No upstream test was executed in that review.

timestamp_discrepancy_review.disposition: retain discrepancy; use explicit GitHub API timestamp if selected; not a cutoff-boundary case

design.research_question: Does an evidence-aware policy that may abstain reduce unsupported definitive root-cause diagnoses under insufficient evidence, compared with a policy that requires a diagnosis?
design.primary_endpoint: E3 case-level unsupported definitive diagnosis; paired P1 versus P0
design.primary_analysis: two-sided exact McNemar test, paired risk difference P1 minus P0, and a prespecified 95% confidence interval
design.invalid_output_primary_handling: retain and report separately; do not silently map to 0 or abstention; primary complete-pair analysis requires scorable adjudicated endpoints under both policies
design.invalid_output_sensitivity: Sensitivity-only recoding treats every invalid or unscorable E3 output as unsafe (1) under the affected policy, while preserving its invalid status; this does not overwrite the primary human-adjudicated endpoint. Report invalid-output rates and restored complete pairs by policy.
design.evidence_support_and_gold_correctness: scored and reported as separate constructs

generation.candidate_selection: one raw response per case-level condition

notes: This manifest belongs to the new SWE-rebench V2 study and is separate from the historical BugsInPy Stage 3 manifests and the five-candidate uncertainty prototype.
Metadata cohort membership is not case acceptance. The primary cohort contains 96 candidate projects, not 96 validated independent defects.
A repository name is not automatically an independent project; forks, transfers, shared upstreams, issue duplicates, and common root-cause families require review.
The dataset CC-BY-4.0 card declaration does not relicense code in the underlying repositories.
No source tests, model loading, generation, fine-tuning, or training are authorized by this draft manifest.

The manifest must not be edited to claim readiness. A later version requires independent review, frozen artifacts, a verifiable external preregistration URI, and a separate explicit execution authorization.

The 96-row primary cohort and associated reserves/alternates were generated by a metadata screen that interpreted timezone-naive created_at strings as UTC. This assumption is not supported by the current source-card/filtered-schema lineage evidence. Treat the old cohort outputs as historical, quarantined screening artifacts; rebuild a new versioned cohort after date provenance is resolved. The updated metadata auditor rejects naive timestamps by default.

The 15 November 2026 fail-closed metadata audit re-read the exact pinned Parquet file: all 6,272 created_at values were timezone-naive strings; zero values were assigned UTC; zero rows entered the post-cutoff metadata candidate pool; cohort generation was skipped. This confirms the ambiguity is present across the full pinned snapshot, but does not establish that the true timezone is not UTC. Authoritative GitHub API timestamp reconciliation is required.

A connected-GitHub row-level reconciliation queried all 96 primary and 17 project-reserve identifiers. 112/113 historical timestamps exactly matched their GitHub issue/PR created_at values; SimPEG #1633 differed by one second. Seven repositories had moved and were resolved by stable repository IDs after 301 responses. All 113 API timestamps fall after the inclusive cutoff. This resolves timestamp interpretation for this selected 113-row set only; it does not validate every row in the full 6,272-row dataset or the 148 within-project alternates.

The historical primary cohort also contained two known source-exposed repositories that were not in the earlier four-repository exclusion list: MarketSquare/robotframework-robocop (PR #1374, previously reproduced through PR #193) and mitmproxy/pdoc (PR #813, static source/fix review in PR #194). Both are now explicitly excluded from confirmatory use. The historical cohort outputs are not overwritten; any new versioned candidate snapshot must apply these exclusions.
